subject: Medford Street Resident Permit Parking Variances
overview: The Commission approved resident permit parking variances for occupants of Sunnyside Terrace and Bellevue Terrace to mitigate parking scarcity caused by new Green Line extension regulations. The body also authorized a new safety marking on Forest Street to enhance pedestrian visibility near the Chevalier Theater.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the approval of the October 11, 2022, meeting minutes until the following month.

items.title: Woodbine Road Parking Variance
items.summary: Tabled the permit parking variance request for 72 College Ave at Woodbine Road for one month because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: Sunnyside Terrace Parking Variances
items.summary: Approved resident permit parking variances and two visitor passes each for units 2 through 6 of Sunnyside Terrace to allow parking on Medford Street due to private way constraints.

items.title: Bellevue Terrace Parking Variances
items.summary: Approved resident parking permits and two visitor passes for Bellevue Terrace residents, treating the private way units as if they were addressed on Medford Street for permit eligibility.

items.title: Forest Street Safety Signage
items.summary: Approved the installation of a 'Do Not Block the Box' sign and pavement markings on Forest Street at the Chevalier Theater crosswalk to improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
